Small, fixed data set for tests/build.e2e.ts cases that must not depend on
real listings (built with SITE_DATA=tests/fixtures/data). Two weekly rules
(Wednesday open mic, Saturday karaoke) and two one-offs on Tue Oct 27 and
Wed Oct 28, 2026. Other events: trivia on Wed Oct 28 (a night with music) and
bingo on Fri Jun 4, 2027 (a night with none). Nothing is comedy, and nothing
happens on Tuesdays in 2027.
